# RFC 2578 section 7.9 writes an OBJECT IDENTIFIER default as a single
# descriptor naming an already-registered node, not as a list of
# sub-identifiers. The list form is not in the grammar, and it says
# plainly enough which node it means to be worth keeping.
#
# The braces are doubled here. The same list at one brace level is the
# fixture next door, because that spelling collides with the integer
# default and a reader that stops at the first number returns 1 for
# 1.3.6.1.
code smi/non-conforming-oid-default
